additional_info.body:
Dear Jan,
After a thorough review, we regret to inform you that your claim regarding the charger has been declined. The primary reason for this decision is that the charger is out of warranty.
We understand that this may be disappointing news, and we truly appreciate your understanding in this matter. It is important to ensure that all claims are assessed fairly and according to the terms and conditions of our warranty policy.
If you have any other questions or require further information, please do not hesitate to reach out to us. We are more than happy to assist you and provide any additional support you may need.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Best,
Philipp
